notes.title: Ready for a New Premiere!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce the latest update to our game on STEAM. This update brings a range of improvements that we are sure you will love.

[list]
[*]Original sound track.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Sound effects.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Graphic improvements.
[/list]
[list]
[*]User Interface
[/list]

We have added brand new original tracks and sound effects to the game. This means that you can enjoy a completely new audio experience that has been specially created for this update.

In addition, we have also included new graphics enhancinf the visuals of the game and give it a fresh, new look, like the addition of shadows. Furthermore, these graphic improvements were specifically made to prevent any confusion when playing levels with two floors.

User interface is improved now is easier to manage your cast information all at once and to know starting roles and character rotations.

We believe that these updates will significantly improve your gameplay experience and we can't wait for you to try them out! As always, we appreciate your feedback and are committed to making further improvements to the game in the future.

Thank you for playing and happy gaming!
